optcg_app.text: OP.TCG | One Piece TCG Collection Manager & Price Tracker (iOS & Android) Skip to content Available on iOS & Android Manage your One Piece TCG collection. The companion app loved by 250K+ collectors . Free download · No ads · Cross-platform sync 20,000+ cards & sealed Every card and sealed product (boosters, decks, displays) in French, English, Japanese and Chinese (exclusive illustrations), across 225+ series. Updated within hours of every new release. The most accurate prices Live prices from Cardmarket, TCGPlayer, eBay and PSA, with full historical charts. Choose from 10+ currencies. Jump to any marketplace in one tap to buy or sell. AI card scanner Point your camera and the AI auto-detects cards in real time, no tap needed. Scan entire bulks in seconds and keep a full history of every scan. Decks & tournament meta Build unlimited decks with advanced stats and cost. Import in one tap the top decks from the current meta, past metas and the biggest tournament results. Friends & trading Add friends and browse their collection, decks and favorite lists. See what cards they want to buy or sell to find the perfect trade. Cross-device sync Sign in with Apple or Google, no subscription needed. Your collection, decks and favorites stay in sync across iPhone, iPad and Android. Switch devices anytime without losing anything. 250K+ Downloads 4.9 App Store rating 4.8 Google Play rating 45K+ Instagram followers Built for collectors and players A look at the app in action. Premium Go further with OP.TCG PLUS Unlock the full power of OP.TCG with an optional subscription. Monthly, annual or one-time Lifetime. Collection valuation See your collection value evolve daily. Card & sealed prices Trend, average, minimum for every product. AI card scanner Snap a card with your camera and add it instantly. Unlimited favorites Bookmark and organize cards in any list. Top meta decks Current tournament decks with share %. Deck & series valuation Know the estimated value of any deck or series. Advanced filters Fine-grained search and upcoming features. Pay once, use everywhere One purchase, synced across iOS and Android. Frequently asked questions Everything else you might want to know. What is OP.TCG? OP.TCG is a free iOS and Android app to manage your One Piece Trading Card Game collection. It covers cards and sealed products in French, English, Japanese and Chinese, with the most accurate live prices, profit tracking, AI scanner, deck builder, tournament decks and a friends system to swap and trade. Is OP.TCG free? Yes. OP.TCG is free to download and use. An optional premium plan called OP.TCG PLUS unlocks the collection value tracker, advanced price stats, AI card scanner, meta & tournament decks, and unlimited favorite lists. Which cards are supported? OP.TCG covers 20,000+ cards and sealed products (boosters, decks, displays) in French, English, Japanese and Chinese (with exclusive illustrations), across 225+ series. New sets are added within hours of every official release. Where do the prices come from? Prices are aggregated from Cardmarket, TCGPlayer, eBay, PriceCharting and PSA. The source is always displayed next to each price, with a full historical chart and 10+ currencies to choose from. You can jump to any marketplace in one tap. Prices are informational only. See our terms for details. How do I switch to Lifetime? Lifetime is a one-time purchase , not a subscription. Apple and Google don't allow switching directly from a subscription to a one-time purchase. To upgrade to Lifetime: cancel your current subscription in your App Store or Google Play account settings, wait until the active period expires, then purchase the Lifetime plan from the OP.TCG PLUS screen. Can I log my own info on each card? Yes. For each card you can add a purchase date and price, the card condition, a free-text note, and details if you plan to sell it. Everything stays private to your account. Can I share my collection with friends? Yes. Add friends in the app and browse their collection, decks and favorite lists. See which cards they want to buy or sell, perfect for finding trades. How do I delete my account? You can delete your account directly from the app settings, or send a request to [email protected] . Your data is deleted within 30 days. Ready to track every card? Join 160,000+ One Piece TCG collectors. Free, no ads, all platforms. The One Piece Card Game collection manager for iOS & Android. mugitcg.text: Mugi TCG — One Piece Card Game Collection Tracker & Scanner Impact-Site-Verification: 5acd8754-af58-49ad-8d77-103c345c6850 Your One Piece TCG companion Scan cards, track live prices with alerts, build winning decks, play the meta with top tournament decklists, and share your collection with friends. Download on the App Store 4,500+ cards available Everything you need for the One Piece card game Built for collectors and players. Scan, track, build, and compete — all from one app. Scan One Piece cards in seconds Point your camera at any One Piece TCG card and Mugi identifies it instantly — down to the exact art variant — and adds it straight to your collection. Every scan is saved to your scan gallery. Track live prices across every marketplace Browse 4,500+ cards with daily prices from TCGPlayer, Cardmarket, and Yuyu-tei. See price history charts, lowest listings, graded PSA values, and jump straight to the marketplace to buy. Build winning decks Create decks around any leader, import and export community-standard decklists, log your matches, and study your win rate per matchup. Print proxies as a PDF or share your deck as an image. Play the meta Follow the competitive One Piece TCG scene with ranked meta archetypes and real tournament results — complete with standings, per-placement decklists, and one-tap import into your own decks. Organize your collection your way Track every card you own with set-completion progress, build custom collections with colors and icons, and watch your collection s value evolve with a 14-day value chart. Price alerts New Never miss a deal. Set an alert on any card or sealed product — pick TCGPlayer, Cardmarket, or Yuyu-tei, set your target price, and get a push notification the moment it drops below or rises above it. Your wishlist is monitored for price drops automatically. Friends New Share the hobby. Add friends with your invite ID, browse their collections and decks, check their deck stats, and import their decks into your own list. You decide what you share — private data stays private. Graded card prices PSA graded values next to raw prices, so you know what your slabs are worth. Match tracking Log results per deck and see your win rate and matchup breakdown. Proxy printing Turn any deck into a print-ready proxy PDF for playtesting. Sealed products Track booster boxes and sealed items with prices and alerts too. Wishlist Flag the cards you re hunting and get notified when they drop in price. Home screen widget Keep your collection stats on your iPhone home screen. Frequently Asked Questions Got questions? We ve got answers. Is Mugi TCG an official Bandai app? No. Mugi TCG is an independent, fan-made tool for managing your One Piece TCG collection. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Bandai, Toei Animation, or Shueisha. All card images, names, and trademarks belong to their respective owners. What One Piece TCG sets are supported? Mugi TCG supports all officially released One Piece TCG sets, including Booster Packs, Starter Decks, Extra Boosters, and Promo cards. The catalog is updated regularly with new releases and price data. How does the card scanner work? Point your camera at any One Piece TCG card and Mugi identifies it in seconds — including the exact art variant — and adds it straight to your collection. It works offline on your device using image recognition, and keeps a gallery of everything you ve scanned. How accurate are the prices? Mugi pulls live market prices daily from TCGPlayer, Cardmarket, and Yuyu-tei, plus graded prices for PSA slabs. Each card shows ungraded and graded values, price history charts, lowest listing, and a direct link to buy. Can I get notified when a card s price changes? Yes. Set a price alert on any card or sealed product: choose the marketplace (TCGPlayer, Cardmarket, or Yuyu-tei), a target price, and whether to be notified when it drops below or rises above it. Mugi checks prices daily and sends you a push notification when your target is crossed. Cards on your wishlist are also monitored for price drops automatically. Can I share my collection and decks with friends? Yes. Add friends with your personal invite ID and browse each other s collections and decks. You can see how many cards and decks a friend has, explore their collection with full filters, view their deck stats, and even import a friend s deck into your own deck list. You control whether your data is shared. Can I import or export my decks? Yes. Mugi supports the standard One Piece TCG decklist format used across the community, so you can paste in a decklist from anywhere or copy yours out to share with friends. You can also export a deck as a shareable image or print proxies as a PDF. The complete One Piece TCG companion Scan, track prices, build winning decks and play the meta — all in one place. grandlinebinder.text: Grand Line Binder — One Piece TCG Collection App Features FAQ Download on Google Play Free for Android One Piece TCG collection manager Keep track of every card you own, build decks, scan cards with your camera, and check live market prices — all offline-first. Get it on Google Play Features Everything in one place Built for people who play and collect One Piece TCG. No subscription, no account required. 📷 Card Scanner Point your camera at any One Piece TCG card and it reads the code automatically. Works even with partial OCR errors — O vs 0, I vs 1. 📦 Binder System Organize cards into named binders. Browse by set and see a live completion bar showing how close you are to completing each set. 🃏 Deck Builder Build and validate tournament-legal decks. Includes opening hand simulator, text export, and deck duplication. 💰 Live Prices Market prices synced live to every card. See the total value of your collection and open Cardmarket directly from any card. 🏆 Meta Tracker Current tournament standings and top deck lists from Limitless TCG. Check what's performing before your next event. 🔄 Borrow Tracker Track cards lent to or borrowed from friends. Grouped by person, with copy counts and return status. ♥ Wishlist Save cards you're looking for and set a target price. Get a visual alert when the price drops below your target. 📊 Collection Stats Breakdown by color, type, rarity, and value. Set completion percentages and total card counts across all your binders. Live Prices Know what your cards are worth Prices are pulled live from OPTCG API and cached on your device. Every card in your collection shows its current market value, and you can jump straight to Cardmarket to buy or sell. Set a target price on any wishlist card and the bell icon turns green when it drops below that number. Borrow Tracker Stop forgetting who has your cards Log every card you've lent to or borrowed from someone. Grouped by person, with the option to mark cards as returned. It sounds simple but it's genuinely useful when you're trading at locals. Collection Track your set completion Every set shows a completion bar so you can see at a glance which sets you're close to finishing. Filter by set, sort by rarity or name, and scan in new cards directly from the collection view. 3,900+ cards bundled locally — works fully offline once downloaded. Questions Is it actually free? ▾ Yes, completely. There are small banner ads to keep the lights on, but every feature is available without paying anything. No premium tier, no subscription. How does the scanner work? ▾ It takes a photo, runs OCR on it, and looks for the card code printed at the bottom of every One Piece TCG card (e.g. OP01-001). It handles common OCR mistakes like O vs 0 and I vs 1. If the code is hard to read, it falls back to name matching. Which sets are in the app? ▾ All English sets: OP01–OP15, EB01–EB04, PRB01, Starter Decks ST01–ST29, and Promos. The database refreshes automatically from multiple sources every 24 hours. Can I back up my collection? ▾ Yes. Settings has an export option that saves everything — collection, decks, wishlist, borrows, folders — to a JSON file. Import it on any Android device to restore.
